svg.title: Pulkit Chauhan
svg.desc: Pulkit Chauhan. Final-year CS student who builds fast, tested systems in C++, Go, Python and TypeScript. Diagram of five systems he built: PitchFork turns the raw NASDAQ feed into every stock's order book (459.8M messages in 51.6 s); sample-platform is CCExtractor's CI API (79 operations, 330+ tests); k8n turns Kubernetes resources into an editable graph (9 MCP tools, dry-run first); Undercover keeps one cheat-proof game state over Socket.IO and Redis; Band-Former turns audio into a playable guitar tab. UPES Dehradun, graduating May 2027. Google Summer of Code 2026 with CCExtractor, 34 commits merged. Codeforces peak 1986, Candidate Master. LeetCode Knight. AWS Solutions Architect Associate. Available full-time from January 2027.
